answer: To curb Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce hardware enclave attestation. At the dawn of enrollment, an agent presents cryptographic quotes signed by silicon-fused keys to verify authentic execution. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of purchasing physical secure processors per identity. While defensive reliability reaches its zenith through hardware scarcity, unpatched microarchitectural side channels can expose signing keys, plunging trust to an insecure nadir.
